proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL matsya subsection 1 explicitly gives Gawri maċoṭá/mačoṭá fish and eastern Bengali māch/Assamese mās. Gawri macoṭa and the selected Bengali/Hajong affricate fish responses are grouped with these documented comparanda. Source aspiration, affricate notation and vowel length remain intact; regional IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: matśʰ.
